b: In Hoi An it's the custom to float beautiful lanterns on the river like little boats.. Lots of people come for this.. The five of us got into a boat, went out into the middle of the river and set our lanterns on the water.. If you've come as a couple, you're supposed to wish to stay a couple as you let it go… I let mine go wishing to find a partner..

After that we bought and ate a dish called banh mi, like a submarine, at a street stall.. I'll tell you about it in the next chapter.. Some people went to change money. At one shop a man was selling "herbal juice": our orange juice with ginger, garlic and rare herbs from the Amazon forests and whatnot.. Mithra and I bought it and drank it

Then we sat at the entrance of a shop called Highlands and talked late into the night.. Mostly politics.. We talked about how we were going to develop our country.. When Sing Keeth becomes President in 2029, we'll be the big shots in the cabinet.. Then we'll develop the country by putting cable cars everywhere.. Some people will ask what for, right.. For them we'll put in a cable car across the sea and connect it to Ba Na Hills.. People who come back after seeing it won't say a thing..(If reading this makes you sad to think that you paid taxes to educate us, don't meet us in person… you'll be even sadder)

I don't know how long we talked… but as soon as we got up, as if they'd been waiting for it, they shut the shop and the workers left… Poor things.. But even after that there was a bit of room left in our stomachs… We bought pancakes at another shop, ate them, and walked to the rooms..

This is the important part of the story…We were all very tired.. Upstairs one bed.. downstairs two beds.. There were three of us boys..Saying three people can't squeeze in and sleep when tired, we said we'd sleep downstairs… Fairly, they should have given it to us..They said they wouldn't give it.. Not listening to them, we occupied the bed

That's when it was like "look at Ganga, fully turned into Chandramukhi".. Like women in films fighting at the roadside to fill their water pots, the two of them came, grabbed our legs, dragged us and pushed us onto the floor.. We fell.. But like those who claim no dust stuck to their moustache, we came back … then it was all hitting and kicking, cutting and stabbing… With bloody wounds we admitted defeat and went upstairs

Well, the upstairs room is the nice room after all … we went up to sleep, and the AC wasn't working .. We put on the fan and slept in the stew…Tomorrow it's their turn to sleep upstairs.. We decided not to tell them this AC story
note: In the Tamil film Chandramukhi (2005), the gentle Ganga is possessed and turns into the fierce Chandramukhi. "No dust on the moustache" describes someone who falls but refuses to admit it. 304 (in the next chapter) is a popular Sri Lankan card game.
